nodes.rule: retrieve only directly relevant material needed to establish what destination already knows
preserve evidence and uncertainty while adding publication-grade factual discipline, consequence mapping, market relevance, emerging-market depth and digital clarity

execution_routing.boundary: Marketing declares bounded work units and required quality/tools/risk. Harness selects deterministic/model/human lane, provider/model, concurrency, attempt ceiling and escalation.
usage_policy: deterministic work must not consume model usage
select lowest-cost permitted available provider adequate for the classified lane
wide separable work requests wide-parallel rather than serial high-cost reasoning
escalate only after bounded failure or verification need
respect provider health, permissions, tools and data sensitivity
record routing telemetry including tokens, estimated cost and work allowance when available

wide_parallel.note: Marketing never assumes a provider. Harness owns live provider health and selection; Kimi K3 may be used when its runtime health gate passes.

editorial_intelligence.purpose: Turn verified EMRADAR intelligence into recognisably EMRADAR publication-grade copy before destination adaptation.

reference_texture.Reuters: factual discipline, attribution, restraint, information density
reference_texture.Financial Times: systems thinking, bottlenecks, second-order consequences, financial context
reference_texture.The Economist: thesis compression and conceptual framing without importing certainty or cleverness
reference_texture.Rest of World: emerging-market ground truth, local consequences, people and industrial reality
reference_texture.Semafor: modular digital clarity and mobile readability

editorial_intelligence.rule: Synthesize editorial qualities; never imitate, mimic or reproduce a publication's distinctive voice or wording.
editorial_intelligence.sequence: EMRADAR evidence -> novelty/delta -> editorial intelligence -> editorial quality gate -> destination adaptation
editorial_intelligence.state_language: UNKNOWN, INVESTIGATE, FORMING, CONFIRMED and WATCH/NO SIGNAL must remain explicit where material.

scan_marketing_parallelism.rule: Marketing intelligence begins as soon as a candidate formation has enough evidence for bounded analysis; external distribution waits for final scan evidence/state gates.
scan_marketing_parallelism.reuse: Scanner public-source research is reused as the initial narrative baseline. Marketing performs additional search only for destination-specific or unresolved gaps.

narrative_timeline.purpose: Measure how EMRADAR interpretation compares with the public narrative over time without hindsight contamination.
narrative_timeline.t0: Persist scan timestamp, evidence available at scan time, EMRADAR interpretation/state, narrative baseline and UNKNOWNs.
compare: where public coverage entered the story
narrative_timeline.rule: Later reporting may validate or falsify earlier EMRADAR reasoning but must never be backfilled into the T0 evidence set.
narrative_timeline.claims: Do not claim EMRADAR was first unless timestamped evidence supports it.
